hero.eyebrow: For Ninja grills, air fryers and CREAMi
hero.subtitle: CookPilot knows the exact model on your counter — its programs, its limits, its accessories — and adapts every recipe to it. No more guessing which setting the recipe meant.
hero.note: Free plan available. No card required.

features.title: Recipes are easy to find. Ones written for your model are not.

appliance.title: Knows your exact model
appliance.body: An AF101 is not an AF300. CookPilot keeps a documented sheet for each model — programs, temperature ranges, accessories — and never assumes two similar names behave the same.

chef.title: A chef you can talk to
chef.body: Ask for a dish, list what is in your fridge, or paste an oven recipe to adapt. The chef asks when something is unclear instead of guessing.

provenance.title: Honest about where recipes come from
provenance.body: Every recipe is labelled Verified, Adapted or Generated. You always know whether it was physically tested on your model or is an AI suggestion.

cooking.title: Guided cooking mode
cooking.body: One big step at a time, your appliance settings on screen, as many timers as you need — built for a phone propped up next to messy hands.

safety.title: Food safety built in
safety.body: Safe internal temperatures and allergy warnings are added to every recipe, and the chef never recommends a program your appliance does not have.

bilingual.title: English and French, metric and imperial
bilingual.body: Switch language and units whenever you like. Grams or ounces, °C or °F — every recipe follows your preferences.

how.title: From “what’s for dinner?” to the plate in three steps

add.title: Add your appliances
add.body: Pick your models from the catalogue. If yours is missing, request it — we never pretend to support a model we have not documented.

ask.title: Ask your chef
ask.body: Tell CookPilot what you feel like eating or what you have on hand. It builds a recipe around your appliance’s real programs.

cook.title: Cook step by step
cook.body: Follow the guided mode, run timers, ask for help mid-recipe and rate the result to improve your next suggestions.

appliances.title: A catalogue built on documented facts
appliances.body: Each model shows how complete its documentation is. Where we could not confirm a detail, we say so instead of filling the gap.
appliances.more: More models and manufacturers are added as their documentation is verified. Missing yours? Request it from the app.

pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you cook more.

official.a: No. CookPilot is an independent product, not affiliated with or endorsed by SharkNinja. Our recipes are original and none of them is an official manufacturer recipe.

models.a: Today the catalogue covers selected Ninja indoor grills, air fryers and CREAMi models, each with a status showing how complete its documentation is. The catalogue is designed to grow to other models and brands. You can request a missing model from the app.

tested.a: Each recipe says so. “Verified” means it was physically tested on that exact model. “Adapted” means it was adapted from a documented recipe. “Generated” means it is an AI recommendation that has not been physically tested — use it as a well-informed starting point and check doneness yourself.

free.q: What does the free plan include?
free.a: One registered appliance, five AI recipe generations per month, the public recipe library, guided cooking mode and up to ten favourites.

data.a: We store only what the service needs. Dietary and allergy information is optional. You can export or delete everything from Settings at any time.

cancel.q: Can I cancel Pro whenever I want?
cancel.a: Yes. Cancel from your account in two clicks; you keep Pro until the end of the period you already paid for.

cta.title: Cook with what you already own
cta.body: Set up your kitchen in two minutes and ask your first question.

about.title: Cooking advice that respects your appliance — and your trust
about.intro: Most recipes are written for “an air fryer” or “a grill”. But the appliance on your counter has its own programs, its own temperature limits and its own quirks.
about.story: CookPilot was built for people who own Ninja appliances and are tired of translating generic recipes into the buttons they actually have. It keeps a careful, documented sheet for each model, and an AI chef that is only allowed to use what that sheet contains.

exact.title: Exact models, not look-alikes
exact.body: Two appliances with similar names can have different programs. We document each model separately and never copy capabilities from one to another.

honest.title: Honest labels
honest.body: Verified means physically tested on that model. Adapted and Generated mean exactly what they say. When our documentation has a gap, we show it.

safe.title: Safety before convenience
safe.body: Safe internal temperatures, allergy flags and your appliance’s documented limits are checked on every answer, automatically.

independent.title: Independent
independent.body: CookPilot is not affiliated with any manufacturer. We do not reuse manufacturer recipes or imagery; our content is original.
